scoring_justification: Recomputing Ewald sums in the verifier is heavy; the values are fixed physical constants for the ideal structure, so T0 with tolerances is sufficient.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for α11, α33, E_I coefficient, and Madelung constant.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Eq. (40) and surrounding text; the reported numerical results of the Ewald calculation.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly extracted from the paper’s published lattice sums (-1.428, -1.518, 0.104, 4.374).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper’s own computed values, traceable to the explicit result in Appendix I.

EI_coefficient.description: Coefficient such that E_I = coeff × f e / c²

madelung_constant.description: Total Madelung constant (positive, absolute value of the sum α^11+α^22+α^33)

outputs.description: Computed lattice sums for ideal wurtzite: α^11, α^33, E_I coefficient, and positive Madelung constant.

output_contract.notes: The Madelung constant must be reported as a positive number (absolute value).
